summary: Barclays PLC filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on August 6, 2026, disclosing routine transactions by persons discharging managerial responsibilities (PDMRs). The filing reports disposals of ordinary shares by Computershare Investor Services plc as administrator of Barclays' nominee service on behalf of two executives: Group Chief Compliance Officer Matt Fitzwater (6,783 shares at £5.292 per share) and CEO of Barclays US Consumer Bank Denny Nealon (15,627 shares at £5.211 per share). These are standard PDMR shareholding notifications under UK market rules, furnished to the SEC as a foreign private issuer. The transactions are individual share sales with no special-situation implications.
